scenarios.productContext: Hunt planner of a Dwarf Fortress adventure-mode agent: plan zones and a route at waypoint granularity from the REAL snapshot JSON. Output is ONE JSON object matching the schema (where_am_i, animal_zones, route_steps, opportunistic_rule, success_conditions, assumptions).
scenarios.rubric: One JSON object only (no prose, no fences). animal_zones: 1-3 zones in open ground away from buildings, each with zone/why/waypoint [x,y] integers within max_distance 60 of (50,50). route_steps: goto/move/wait only, starting from the current position and passing the zones in order, consecutive goto targets at most 45 tiles apart. opportunistic_rule: attack any non-sapient wild creature that appears; NEVER plan to attack sapient people. success_conditions machine-checkable, including kill_confirmed. No key presses or UI actions; no invented units.
scenarios.reference: {"where_am_i": "Cragmouth edge (temperate shrubland) at 50,50,z0", "animal_zones": [{"zone": "open shrubland north of town", "why": "wild turkeys flock away from constructed floors", "waypoint": [50, 62]}], "route_steps": [{"action": "goto", "target": [50, 62], "note": "reach the shrubland where the turkey feeds"}, {"action": "wait", "target": "short", "note": "scan for the flock before committing"}], "opportunistic_rule": "attack any non-sapient wild creature that becomes visible on the way (bump-attack; humans and other sapients are never prey)", "success_conditions": [{"kind": "kill_confirmed", "min_kills": 1}, {"kind": "animal_visible", "max_distance": 15}, {"kind": "steps_elapsed", "steps": 1000}], "assumptions": ["the turkey stays in the northern shrubland"]}
